spans.s: उहन्, Ved. a wrong reading for उदन्.
उहान, अस्, m., N. of a country.
ऊहन, अम्, n. reasoning, inferring, concluding.

1. ऊह, अस्, m. change, modification.
—ऊह-गान,
अम्, n. or ऊह-गीति, इस्, f., N. of the third Gāna or
song book of the Sāma-veda.

2. ऊह, अस्, m. deliberation, examination; reason-
ing; understanding; completing a defective sentence
or verse, supplying an ellipsis; [cf. Hib. uga, ‘choice,
election.’]
